title: Sky Tower
blurb: Auckland’s 328 m observation and telecommunications tower, opened in 1997: a tapered concrete shaft carries the main pod with its observation decks and revolving restaurant, a smaller SkyDeck pod, and the antenna mast.

systems.name: Base and podium
systems.description: The SKYCITY complex podium the tower rises from (schematic).

systems.name: Concrete shaft
systems.description: The tapered reinforced-concrete shaft carrying the pod, engineered for 200 km/h winds and a magnitude 8.0 earthquake.

systems.name: Main pod
systems.description: The main pod at 170 to 212 m with Levels 50 to 53: Sky Bar, main observation deck, Orbit 360 revolving restaurant and lookout.

systems.name: SkyDeck pod
systems.description: The smaller SkyDeck observatory pod at 220 m, with views to 82 km.

systems.name: Mast and spire
systems.description: The tapered telecommunications mast rising to 328 m.

systems.name: Telecom equipment
systems.description: Antenna dishes, panels and aviation warning lights (schematic placement).

systems.name: Architectural lighting
systems.description: Floodlighting used for commemorative lightings and the New Year show (schematic).
